security_nonrenewal_002.evidence: If a teacher does not reach “Basic” performance at the completion of a one-year Performance Improvement Plan, the evaluator may recommend non-renewal of contract, completion of a second PIP, or reassignment to another of the teacher's areas of certification in which he or she has experience in the IPS system if such a vacancy exists.
